events.summary: All channels: 96.1% ± 4.5 vs 27.0% ± 13.6 for current practice (% of working parents who heard within 3 days). P3 wins because it reaches 96.1% ± 4.5 of working parents within 3 days, compared with 27.0% ± 13.6 under current practice. It also matches or exceeds the best held-out results in two of three scenarios (95.5% vs 95.5% in A and B) while staying far above current practice in every scenario.
events.assumptions: The result depends on synthetic/model-default resident schedules and word-of-mouth/arrival rates. It also assumes the board and bulletin channels exist locally even though no local source here explicitly confirms them.
